entities.name: Halquina
entities.description: Archipelago in southwestern Terisiare, once the mountainous southern province of Almaaz; its mountains were ground into the sea after the Ice Age.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria in which Halquina lies.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: Province/main island of which Halquina was the southern province.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: More northerly province contrasting with Halquina.

entities.name: Sarraza
entities.description: Place on one of the Halquina islands.

entities.name: River Kingdom
entities.description: Place on one of the Halquina islands.

entities.name: Great Glacier
entities.description: Ice that buried the Halquina mountains when the Ice Age began.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era in which the Great Glacier buried Halquina's mountains.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War after which the Halquina mountains still stood.

entities.name: Dark Age
entities.description: Era through which the Halquina mountains lasted.

events.summary: When the Ice Age began, the Halquina mountains were buried under the Great Glacier; when the ice retreated they had been ground into the sea, leaving islands.
events.quote: when the Ice Age started, they were buried under the Great Glacier

relations.quote: Halquina formed the southern province of Almaaz
The songmage Samor was from Halquina
